course.title: Complete C Programming Master Guide
course.subtitle: Beginner to Advanced Full C Language Course
course.description: A complete and detailed C programming course covering fundamentals, memory management, pointers, arrays, functions, structures, file handling, data structures, algorithms, operating system concepts, and advanced C programming with examples and projects.

modules.overview: This module explains the basics of C programming language, history, features, structure of C program, compilation process, and first program.

content.creator: Dennis Ritchie
content.description: C is a procedural programming language developed for system programming and operating systems.
importantPoints: Used in operating systems and embedded systems

features.name: Simple
features.explanation: C has a simple syntax and structure.

features.name: Portable
features.explanation: Programs can run on multiple platforms.

features.name: Efficient
features.explanation: C programs execute quickly.

features.name: Structured Language
features.explanation: Programs are divided into functions.

features.name: Low-Level Access
features.explanation: Supports direct memory manipulation using pointers.

modules.overview: Variables store values and data types define memory allocation.

topics.title: Variables
topics.description: Variables in C are named memory locations used to store data that can be modified during program execution.

topics.title: Arithmetic Operators
topics.description: Arithmetic operators are used to perform mathematical calculations like addition, subtraction, and modulus.

topics.title: If Statement
topics.description: The if statement in C is used to execute a block of code only if a specified condition is true.

topics.title: Loops
topics.description: Loops allow the execution of a set of statements multiple times. C supports for, while, and do-while loops.

forLoop.description: Used when the number of iterations is known.

whileLoop.description: Used when the iterations depend on a condition.

doWhileLoop.description: Executes at least once before checking the condition.

topics.title: Pointer Basics
topics.description: Pointers are variables that store the memory address of another variable. They are one of C's most powerful features.

projects.name: Calculator
projects.description: A menu-driven calculator project that performs arithmetic operations using functions. It helps students practice switch case, loops, functions, input handling, and division-by-zero validation.

features.name: Menu
features.explanation: Shows operation choices such as add, subtract, multiply, divide, and exit.

features.name: Functions
features.explanation: Each operation can be written as a separate reusable function.

features.name: Validation
features.explanation: The program checks invalid choices and division by zero.

projects.name: Student Management System
projects.description: A record management project using structures and arrays. It teaches how to group related data, store multiple records, search by roll number, and display results clearly.

features.name: Structure
features.explanation: Use struct Student to store roll number, name, department, and marks.

features.name: Array of Structures
features.explanation: Store multiple student records in one array.

features.name: Search
features.explanation: Loop through the array and compare roll numbers.

projects.name: Bank Management System
projects.description: A console-based banking project that simulates account creation, deposit, withdrawal, balance checking, and transaction validation. It is useful for understanding structures, functions, and file storage.

features.name: Create Account
features.explanation: Store account number, holder name, and opening balance.

features.name: Deposit
features.explanation: Add money to the account balance.

features.name: Withdraw
features.explanation: Check balance before reducing money.

features.name: File Storage
features.explanation: Save account details so data is not lost after closing the program.

steps: Create a structure for account data
Write functions for deposit and withdraw

projects.name: Library Management System
projects.description: A project for managing books, issue records, return records, and availability. It teaches arrays or linked lists, strings, structures, searching, and file handling.

features.name: Add Book
features.explanation: Store book id, title, author, and quantity.

features.name: Issue Book
features.explanation: Reduce quantity when a student borrows a book.

features.name: Return Book
features.explanation: Increase quantity when the book is returned.

features.name: Search Book
features.explanation: Find books by id, title, or author name.

projects.name: Inventory System
projects.description: A stock management application for products, quantity, price, purchase, and sales. It teaches structure arrays, calculations, menu logic, and report generation.

features.name: Product Record
features.explanation: Store product id, name, quantity, and price.

features.name: Stock Update
features.explanation: Increase stock on purchase and reduce stock on sales.

features.name: Billing
features.explanation: Calculate total amount using quantity and price.

features.name: Low Stock Report
features.explanation: Show products that need restocking.

projects.name: C Interview and Debugging Checklist
projects.description: A revision guide for students preparing for C programming tests and interviews. It focuses on concepts that commonly cause mistakes.

features.name: Pointers
features.explanation: Understand address operator, dereference operator, pointer arithmetic, and NULL pointer checks.

features.name: Arrays and Strings
features.explanation: Practice indexing, bounds, character arrays, null terminator, and string functions.

features.name: Memory Management
features.explanation: Use malloc, calloc, realloc, and free carefully to avoid memory leaks.

features.name: Common Errors
features.explanation: Watch for segmentation faults, uninitialized variables, buffer overflow, and missing return values.
